name: broaden_t_wave_morphology_sampling
mechanism: Widens subtype-specific T-wave Gaussian component parameter ranges for LQT1 shoulder delays/widths, LQT2 notch separations and amplitude ratios, and LQT3 late-onset narrowness, increasing generated morphological variability and embedding spread.

name: t_peak_anchor_width_constraint
mechanism: Anchors T-wave component centers to a subtype-specific fraction of the QT interval and clamps component delays and widths so the T-wave onset remains after QRS end, preventing broad T-waves from encroaching on the QRS or ST segment.

name: lead_specific_acquisition_artifacts
mechanism: The child generates independent baseline wander, powerline interference, and high-frequency noise for each lead with broader amplitudes, reducing artificial cross-lead redundancy and increasing inter-subject variability.
code_snippet: lead_I += baseline_wander_I + powerline_I + hf_noise_I; lead_II += baseline_wander_II + powerline_II + hf_noise_II

name: independent_lead_qrs_morphology
mechanism: Sampling independent physiologically plausible QRS morphologies for Lead I and Lead II decouples their high-energy vectors and widens the embedding spread without prolonging QRS duration.
